sn16.11:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam āyasmā Mahā-Kassapo Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe || ||
sn16.11:1.2: I 2 Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Ānando Dakkhiṇāgirismiṃ cārikaṃ carati mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhim || || 3
sn16.11:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmato Ānandassa tiṃsamattā saddhivihārino bhikkhū sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattā bhavanti yebhuyyena kumārabhūtā || || 4
sn16.11:2.2: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando Dakkhiṇāgirismiṃ yathābhirantam cārikaṃ caritvā yena Rājagahaṃ Veḷu vanaṃ kalandakanivāpo yenāyasmā Mahā-Kassapo tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Mahākassapam abhivādatvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 5 Ekam antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantam Ānandam āyasmā Mahā-Kassapo etad avoca || ||
sn16.11:2.3: Kati nu kho āvuso Ānanda atthavase paṭicca Bhagavatā kulesu tikabhojanaṃ paññattanti || || 6
sn16.11:3.1: Tayo kho bhante Kassapa atthavase paṭicca Bhagavatā kulesu tikabhojanam paññattaṃ ||
sn16.11:3.2: dummaṅkūnam puggalānaṃ niggahāya pesalānam bhikkhūnam phāsuviharāya mā papicchā pakkhaṃ nissāya saṅgham bhindeyyuṃ kulānuddayatāya cā || ||
sn16.11:3.3: Ime kho bhante Kassapa tayo atthavase paṭicca Bhagavatā kulesu ti tikabhojanam paññattanti || || 7
sn16.11:4.1: Atha kiñcarahi tvam āvuso Ānanda imehi navehi bhikkhūhi indriyesu aguttadvārehi bhojane amattaññūhi jāgariyam ananuyuttehi saddhiṃ cārikaṃ carasi ||
sn16.11:4.2: sassaghātam maññe carasi kulupaghātam maññe carasi || ||
sn16.11:4.3: Olujjati kho te āvuso Ānanda parisā
sn16.11:5.1: Api me bhante Kassapa sirasmiṃ phalitāni jātāni ||
sn16.11:5.2: atha ca pana mayam ajjāpi āyasmato Mahā-Kassapassa kumārakavādā na muñcamāti || || 9
sn16.11:5.3: Tathā hi pana tvam āvuso Ānanda imehi navehi bhikkhūhi indriyesu aguttadvārehi bhojāne amataññūhi jāgariyam ananuyuttehi saddhiṃ cārikaṃ carasi || sassaghātam maññe carasi kulupaghātam maññe carasi ||
sn16.11:5.4: Olujjati kho te āvuso Ānanda parisā
sn16.11:6.2: ayyena kira Mahā-Kassapena ayyo Ānando vedehamuni kumārakavādena apasādito ti || 11
sn16.11:7.1: Atha kho Thullanandā bhikkhunī anattamanā anattamanavācaṃ nicchāresi || ||
sn16.11:7.2: Kimpana ayyo Mahā-Kassapo aññatitthiyapubbo samāno ayyam Ānandaṃ vedehamuniṃ kumārakavādena apasādetabbam maññatīti || || 12
sn16.11:7.3: Assosi kho āyasmā Mahā-Kassapo Thullanandāya bhikkhuniyā imaṃ vācam bhāsamānāya || || 13
sn16.11:8.1: Atha kho āyasmā Mahā-Kassapo āyasmantam Ānandam etad avoca || ||
sn16.11:8.2: Tagghāvuso Ānanda Thullanandāya bhikkhuniyā sahasā appaṭisaṅkhā vācā bhāsitā ||
sn16.11:8.3: yato ham āvuso kesamassum ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyam pabbajito nābhijānāmi aññaṃ satthāram uddisitum aññatra tena Bhagavatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena || || 14
sn16.11:8.4: Pubbe me āvuso agārikabhūtassa sato etad ahosi || ||
sn16.11:8.6: na yidaṃ sukaraṃ agāram ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇam ekantaparisuddhaṃ saṅkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ || ||
sn16.11:8.7: Yaṃ nunāhaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyam pabbajjeyyanti || || 15
sn16.11:8.8: So khvāham āvuso aparena samayena paṭapilotikānaṃ saṅghāṭiṃ karitvā || ye loke arahanto te uddissa kesamassum ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyam pabbaji || || 16
sn16.11:9.1: So evam pabbajito samāno addhānamaggapaṭipanno addasaṃ Bhagavantam antarā ca Rājagaham antarā ca Nāḷandam Bahuputte cetiye nisinnam ||
sn16.11:9.3: ca vatāham passeyyaṃ Bhagavantam eva passeyyaṃ ||
sn16.11:9.4: Sugataṃ ca vatāham passeyyaṃ Bhagavantam eva passeyyaṃ ||
sn16.11:9.7: So khvāham āvuso tattheva Bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā Bhagavantam etad avocaṃ || ||
sn16.11:9.10: Evaṃ vutte maṃ āvuso Bhagavā etad avoca || ||
sn16.11:9.11: Yo kho Kassapa evaṃ sabbaṃ cetasā samannāgatam sāvakam ajānaññeva vadeyya Jānāmīti || apasaññeva vadeyya Passāmīti || muddhā pi tassa vipateyya || ||
sn16.11:9.12: Aham kho pana Kassapa jānaññeva vadāmi Jānāmīti || passaññeva vadāmi Passamīti || || 19
sn16.11:10.1: Tasmā ti ha te Kassapa evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ || ||
sn16.11:10.2: Tibbaṃ hirottappam paccupaṭṭhitaṃ bhavissati theresu navesu majjhimesūti ||
sn16.11:11.1: Tasmā ti ha te Kassapa evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ || ||
sn16.11:11.2: Yaṃ kiñci dhammaṃ sussāmi kusalūpasañhitam sabbaṃ tam aṭṭhikatvā manasi karitvā sabbaṃ cetasā samannāharitvā ohitasoto dhammaṃ suṇissamīti ||
sn16.11:12.1: Tasmā ti ha te Kassapa evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ || ||
sn16.11:12.2: Sātasahagatā ca me kāyagatā sati na vijahissatīti ||
sn16.11:13.1: Atha kho maṃ āvuso Bhagavā iminā ovādena ovaditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi || || 23
sn16.11:13.2: Satthāhaṃ eva khvāham āvuso sāṇo raṭṭhapiṇḍam bhuñjiṃ || aṭṭhamiyā aññā udapādi || || 24
sn16.11:14.1: Atha kho āvuso Bhagavā maggā okkamma yena aññataraṃ rukkhamūlaṃ tenupasaṅkami || || 25
sn16.11:14.2: Atha khvāham āvuso paṭapilotikānaṃ saṅghātiṃ catugguṇaṃ paññāpetvā Bhagavantam etad avocaṃ || ||
sn16.11:14.3: Idha bhante Bhagavā nisīdatu yam mamassa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti || || 26
sn16.11:14.4: Nisīdi kho āvuso Bhagavā paññatte āsane || || 27
sn16.11:14.5: Nisajja kho mam āvuso Bhagavā etad avoca || ||
sn16.11:14.6: Mudukā kho tyāyaṃ Kassapa paṭapilotikānaṃ saṅghāṭīti || ||
sn16.11:14.7: Paṭigaṇhātu me bhante Bhagavā paṭapilotikānaṃ saṅghāṭiṃ anukampaṃ upādāyāti || || 28
sn16.11:14.8: Dhāressasi pana me tvaṃ Kassapa sāṇāni paṃsukūlāni nibbasanānīti || ||
sn16.11:14.9: Dhāressāmāham bhante Bhagavato sāṇāni paṃsukulāni nibbasanānīti || || 29
sn16.11:14.10: So khvāham āvuso paṭapilotikānaṃ saṅghātiṃ Bhagavato pādāsi ||
sn16.11:14.11: aham pana Bhagavato sāṇāni paṃsukūlāni nibbasanāni paṭipajjiṃ || || 30
sn16.11:15.2: Bhagavato putto oraso mukhato jāto dhammajo dhammanimmito dhammadāyādo patiggahitāni sānāni paṃsukūlāni nibbasanānīti || mamantaṃ sammāvadamaño vadeyya
sn16.11:15.3: Bhagavato putto oraso mukhato jāto dhammajo dhammanimmito dhammadāyādo paṭiggahitāni sāṇāni paṃsukūlāni nibbasanānīti || || 31
sn16.11:16.1: Ahaṃ kho āvuso yāvadeva ākaṅkhāmi vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāram vivekajam pītisukham pathamaṃ jhānam upasampajja viharāmi || 32-46
sn16.11:16.2: Aham kho āvuso yāvadeva ākaṅkhāmi || pe|| ||
sn16.11:16.3: navannam anupubbavihārasamāpattinaṃ pañcannam abhiññānam evam peyyālo || || 47
sn16.11:17.1: Ahaṃ kho āvuso āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmi || || 48
sn16.11:17.2: Sattaratanaṃ vā āvuso nāgam aḍḍhaṭṭharatanaṃ vā tālapattikāya chādetabbam maññeyya yo me cha abhiññā chādetabbaṃ maññeyyāti || || 49
